[build-system] requires = ["setuptools"] build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta" [project] name = "mailkit" version = "0.4.2" description = "Small HTML email rendering helpers" requires-python = ">=3.10" dependencies = ["MarkupSafe==2.1.5"] [tool.setuptools] packages = ["mailkit"] [pytest] testpaths = tests pythonpath = . __pycache__/ .pytest_cache/ *.pyc *.egg-info/ build/ # mailkit Small helpers for rendering transactional HTML emails: template substitution, subject/header formatting and a few display filters. Escaping is delegated to MarkupSafe. ## Setup ``` make dev ``` Dependencies are served from `vendor/` (the package index is not reachable from the build hosts). ## Tests ``` make test ``` ## Layout - `mailkit/render.py` - `{{ name }}` template substitution - `mailkit/filters.py` - display filters (`money`, `truncate`) - `mailkit/headers.py` - subject and header helpers - `mailkit/message.py` - `Message` assembling subject and body from .message import Message from .render import render __all__ = ["Message", "render"] from markupsafe import Markup, escape def money(cents, currency="USD"): sign = "-" if cents < 0 else "" whole, frac = divmod(abs(int(cents)), 100) return f"{sign}{whole:,}.{frac:02d} {currency}" def truncate(value, length=40): text = str(value) if len(text) <= length: return escape(text) return escape(text[: length - 1]) + Markup("…") import re _CRLF = re.compile(r"[\r\n]+") def clean_header(value): return _CRLF.sub(" ", value).strip() def format_subject(prefix, subject): subject = clean_header(subject) if prefix: return f"[{clean_header(prefix)}] {subject}" return subject from .headers import format_subject from .render import render class Message: def __init__(self, subject, template, prefix=None): self.subject = format_subject(prefix, subject) self.template = template def body(self, **context): return render(self.template, **context) def as_dict(self, **context): return {"subject": self.subject, "html": str(self.body(**context))} import re from markupsafe import Markup, escape _PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r"\{\{\s*(\w+)\s*\}\}") def render(template, **context): def substitute(match): name = match.group(1) if name not in context: raise KeyError(name) return str(escape(str(context[name]))) return Markup(_PLACEHOLDER.sub(substitute, template)) from markupsafe import Markup from mailkit import render def test_plain_substitution(): assert render("Hello {{ name }}", name="Ada") == "Hello Ada" def test_escapes_untrusted_text(): assert render("

{{ name }}

", name="x") == "

<b>x</b>

" def test_markup_values_are_not_double_escaped(): link = Markup('reset') assert render("

{{ link }}

", link=link) == '

reset

' def test_unescaped_ampersand_in_markup(): badge = Markup("Q&A") assert render("{{ badge }}", badge=badge) == "Q&A" def test_missing_key(): try: render("{{ nope }}") except KeyError as exc: assert exc.args == ("nope",) else: raise AssertionError("expected KeyError") global.find-links='/work/repo/vendor' global.no-index='true'
